headline: NetEase Shares Slump Following Disappointing Third-Quarter Earnings
summary: Shares in Chinese gaming company NetEase tumbled after its third-quarter financial results missed market expectations.
why: NetEase is one of China's largest online entertainment and gaming companies, making its financial results an indicator of domestic consumer discretionary digital spending.

impacts.name: NetEase
impacts.why: NetEase shares plunged following lower-than-expected third-quarter earnings.
